text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria at noon, I spotted Gold City and Oguri Cap
lining up a massive pile of paper bags
filled with high-end sweets.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Oguri-senpai.
This is what I promised you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...What was it again, farm equipment?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not! These are refreshments
from my modeling gig. You said you wanted
some if there were leftovers, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I didn't quite understand the concept
of being unable to finish eating, so I forgot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I made sure to set aside the ones I got from fans, so feel free to eat all of these without worry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
? You'll eat too, won't you, City? Tama said
there's no better seasoning than eating with someone else.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm actually on a calorie restriction.
I'd love to join you, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey Trainer, you heard that just now, right?
Could you tell them it's a no-go too?
choice_data_list: Self-control is crucial if you want to win!
You've got to take in calories if you want to win!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know, right...? Well, it's not like I didn't see it coming.
Even if there were some from my favorite shops mixed in...
choice_data_list: That's why you're only getting one bite, got it?
That's why you're only getting one bite, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
!! Huh, really?!
W-Well, practice is coming up, but maybe just a bite?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold City enjoyed
just a little bit of delicious sweets.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, you mean *that* one!? B-But it's true, you can't get results running on empty...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If it's come to this, I'm eating it just for today!
Senpai, I highly recommend that chocolate terrine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Terrine... So it wasn't a cake.
Then what could be inside this can...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Opening the bags one by one,
Gold City enjoyed sweets to her heart's content with Oguri Cap."
